results.title: What Does Salesforce’s Braze Deal Mean for Marketing Cloud Customers?
results.content: Acquisition much in customer experience and marketing? Salesforce has now committed about $10.8 billion in disclosed prices to acquisitions of Contentful (content management), Fin (AI customer service) and Braze (customer engagement and marketing) this year alone. That doesn't count a reported $2 billion for its acquisition of Listen Labs, an AI customer research and simulation startup. [...] The following table highlights the most important lessons, actions and strategic considerations emerging from 15 years of Salesforce acquisitions in marketing, commerce, customer data and customer service. Prices reflect the figure Salesforce announced or filed with the SEC unless marked as reported. [...] Salesforce announced Oct. 20 that it signed a definitive agreement to acquire customer engagement platform Braze for approximately $5.66 billion in enterprise value, or $47.50 per share in cash. Braze will strengthen Salesforce Marketing Cloud's real-time, cross-channel personalization for high-volume B2C brands, officials say. The deal needs Braze shareholder and regulatory approval and is expected to close in Salesforce's fiscal 2028, which begins in February 2027.

results.title: What is Sales Enablement? A Complete Strategy Guide | Salesforce
results.content:
Sales enablement starts with clear revenue goals, like increase in win rate, that can be influenced by key enablement efforts. Those efforts include new hire onboarding, ongoing or continuing training for existing employees in the flow of work (including coaching), and, as needed, one-off training for unique company or product moments (like a new product launch).
